tasks.title: The next contract patch matches notify's rules and documents the corrected limits
tasks.spec: ## Repository: contract, R1-R6, test items 1-6, Baseline rule and Completion evidence; Required behavior R1-R6; Evidence and Counterexamples; Security impact; Performance impact; Acceptance evidence 1-3. First write public-validator regression tests and run them on unchanged source (b637302 or later main with src/notify-channels.ts equal to c5ce668): every defect case must fail by assertion and every control must pass. Implement only the six viewText positions using string.length refinements; notify 0464b90's anchored address extraction and trimming; its private EHLO predicate with the existing 200-code-point cap; and never-view failed/failedTotal rules in R4's issue order. Cover every boundary, nested validator, from/to, identity, absent clientName, actual NUL, hostile input and never/fresh/stale case in items 1-6. Preserve other validators, bounds, existing messages, getter safety, never-throw/same-object guarantees, dependencies, src/index.ts exports and WIRE_VERSION 1. Complete every R5 docs bullet. Change only package.json's version to 2.5.1 on today's 2.5.0 main, or the next free patch after main if #823 merges first; name that literal in the PR. Rebuild and commit dist/notify-channels.js, and dist/notify-channels.d.ts only if the build changes it.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; the manifest and committed lockfile agree.

After implementation, 0 fail. Item 1 covers all six 200/300-unit positions, 202/302-unit emoji rejects, mixed 200/201-unit boundaries, empty-string rejects and the two nested admin validators. Items 2-3 cover all R2/R3 Counterexamples, including from and to[0], record/admin paths, same-object returns, actual NUL, absent clientName, 191-character accept and kept 255-character rejection. Item 4 covers all three never contradictions and never/fresh/stale controls, with the exact R4 error literals and ordering. On unchanged source, every defect case of items 1-4 fails by assertion (including changed error text where old code already rejects), every control and item 6 passes; fix any broken control fixture before implementing. Afterward all pass. Both 100000-character hostile inputs reject without throwing, each under 50 ms. Focused coverage exit status is not the test result.
exit 0; lint, build, typecheck and full tests pass, including getter safety, adversarial inputs and smoke checks; the existing 80% line coverage gate passes.

acceptance.command: bun run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist
acceptance.expected: exit 0 after committing rebuilt artifacts; a fresh build produces no further tracked dist changes.

src/index.ts has no diff; package.json changes only version from 2.5.0 to 2.5.1 on today's main, or from the main version to the next free patch literal stated in the PR if another patch merges first. The dependency set stays unchanged.
Prints the literal 2.5.1, or the next free patch literal independently established from main and named in the PR per Goal/R6; the version never goes backwards and is a patch increment.
0 fail; the existing assertion WIRE_VERSION === 1 stays true. Ignore only a focused-run global coverage failure; full-suite coverage is checked by bun run check.

All R5 bullets are documented: NotifyFailedEvent's eight NOTIFY_FAILED_EVENTS literals; ResendCommandState's nine RESEND_COMMAND_STATES literals; six report text limits count UTF-16 units while the section's other text limits count code points; never means null receivedAt, empty failed and zero failedTotal; final angle-bracket extraction/trimming; the ASCII host-name or address-literal clientName rule and kept 200 cap; the chosen patch literal and wire version 1.
exit 0; contract CI check passes, including frozen install and the committed-dist check.

Records every items 1-4 defect's assertion failure on unchanged source, explicitly states every control passed there, and records all passing after the change. Contains the full R2/R3 Evidence table run through the new public validateNotifyChannelDefinition, matching notify 0464b90's independent boolean column for each row, release/docs/dist evidence, and bun test wall times before/after (no A/B bench required). Includes the applicable Security impact checklist: input validation/getter safety; fixed secret-free errors; UTF-16/body limits and hostile-input timings; unchanged dependencies/exports.
